draft_text: Under matched inference conditions, Velora uses less peak GPU memory than Dravik, at 9.6 versus 14.8 GiB.
revised_text: Under matched inference conditions, Velora's measured peak GPU memory was 9.6 GiB; Dravik's peak GPU memory was not measured, so a direct memory comparison is not established. Velora's smaller parameter count (1.3 vs 2.4 billion) provides only indirect, directional evidence about model-weight memory.
rationale: Velora's peak GPU memory (9.6 GiB) was measured, but Dravik's was NOT measured (T1.r2.mem = "Not measured"). The claim's "9.6 versus 14.8 GiB" for Dravik is unsupported; no statistical test was reported for cmp1. The parameter difference (1.3 vs 2.4B) is only indirect evidence.
